hypotheses.title: Options Sentiment Put-Call Open Interest Contrarian Imbalance (option)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly activates the aggregated options sentiment domain (pcr_oi_all) across all maturities, which currently has 0 approved alphas in our database. Put-Call open interest ratios measure structural market participant hedging and speculation. When pcr_oi_all is low (long calls / bullish institutional sentiment), institutional smart money is positioning for upside drift. Conversely, excessive put open interest represents over-hedged panic. Using -pcr_oi_all with signed_power concentrates conviction on equities with aggressive bullish call positioning and low put-hedging drag, with 0% self-correlation against fundamental and call-IV approved alphas.
confounders: Index arbitrage programs skewing single-stock options open interest
Dividend capture trades generating artificial call open interest
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if elevated call open interest is driven purely by covered call selling rather than directional institutional call buying.

candidates.rationale: Industry-neutral contrarian negative put-call open interest ratio with 5-day reversal overlay

hypotheses.title: Microstructure Volume-Weighted Liquidity Shock Reversal (pv1)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly activates intraday microstructure price-volume interactions using close, vwap, volume, and adv20. When an equity's closing price deviates substantially from its volume-weighted average price ((close - vwap) / close) accompanied by an abnormal volume burst (volume / (adv20 + 1)), institutional or retail market orders have temporarily overwhelmed local liquidity. Microstructure liquidity providers earn excess returns by taking the opposing side as prices revert to intrinsic volume-weighted fair value over 3 days. 100% instrument coverage across TOP3000 guarantees zero weight concentration issues and zero correlation to balance sheet fundamentals.
confounders: Fundamental regime-change news causing permanent structural re-pricing rather than temporary liquidity dislocation
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha breaks down during sustained one-way momentum trends where high-volume price moves experience continuous trend continuation.

candidates.expression: -0.85 * signed_power(group_rank((close - vwap) / close * (volume / (adv20 + 1)), industry) - 0.5, 2) - 0.15 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 3) / close, industry)
candidates.rationale: Industry-neutral volume-weighted price deviation shock reversal with 3-day short-term momentum hedge

hypotheses.title: Options Put IV Term Structure Slope / Tail Risk Reversal (option8)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly activates the put implied volatility surface (implied_volatility_put_180 and implied_volatility_put_30), which has 0 approved alphas in our database (all historical approved options alphas used call IVs). In calm markets, options trade in contango where 180-day put IV exceeds 30-day put IV. Acute panic events cause short-term put IV to spike above 180-day put IV (inversion/backwardation). Measuring the term structure slope ((implied_volatility_put_180 - implied_volatility_put_30) / (implied_volatility_put_30 + 0.001)) identifies stocks where short-term crash insurance is cheap relative to long-term baseline, delivering robust alpha with zero overlap to historical call IV alphas.
confounders: Imminent quarterly earnings releases creating justifiable short-term put volatility spikes
Broad equity market systemic volatility contagion
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if short-term put IV spikes accurately anticipate catastrophic bankruptcy or litigation events.

candidates.rationale: Industry-neutral put implied volatility term structure contango with 5-day price reversal overlay
